card.name: Hypo- starting hypoventilation in sedation warnings
card.fires_on: The start of "hypo" or "hyp" in words like hypoventilation, in lists of breathing risks (airway obstruction, apnea) in sedative warnings. Also hyp- before hypoglycemia in a similar list.

modes.label: hypoventilation in lists
